design.purpose: Make a decorative six-pointed paper snowflake for a window or card.

steps.c: Place the 24 cm square sheet flat.
Fold top-right corner onto bottom-left corner.
Fold top-left corner onto bottom-right corner.
Fold top-right edge through top at 30°.
Fold top-left edge through top at 30°.
Cut straight across the wide end.
Cut a triangular notch from one side.
Cut a triangular notch from the other side.
Open the sheet flat to reveal the snowflake.
